summary: All five phases complete and committed. The paper's one-sentence extension of lem:time-reflection to the Stability language is now built in Lean as fifteen declarations with the plan's pinned signatures and real proofs: the carrying lemma sameState_rev_iff promoted into Semantics/Reversal.lean with its image form image_rev_stabClass, the new PlusLanguage/PlusReversal.lean carrying the seven-case plusTruthAt_rev and the L-plus thm:TR-valid family, TaskFrame.deterministic_rev plus the Determined- and deterministic-class closures, and the TR-route decision recorded in the Deterministic soundness docstring after verifying the alternative route actually elaborates. Un-narrowed full build green (2859 jobs, zero errors, olean-newer-than-source on all six touched modules); build-backed check-module-invariants.sh prints ALL CHECKS PASSED; zero sorry, axiom count unchanged at 12. Three gate failures are reasoned exclusions with evidence: two inherited (check-paper-definitions.sh upstream paper drift, check-metalogic-cycles.sh SURPLUS at HEAD) and one vacuous (verify-deploy.sh exits 0 over ZERO checks because gate-registry.data is absent from both the deploy tree and the source store).
